  • Method Details

    • nestedBatchesPublishOnlyAfterTheOuterBatch

      public static void nestedBatchesPublishOnlyAfterTheOuterBatch(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal publication-order check with no direct manual reproduction. Reflection opens two nested batches on each stack type; direct writes fill slots 0 and 1 while local fill updates immediately. Publication is deferred until the outer batch ends, then occurs exactly once. Storage and Singles also assert derived light from glowstone; Bar uses an ordinary accepted ingot. The fixture performs no extraction or collapse.

      For visible Bar collapse checks, see BarColumnChecks.playerExtractionDropsUnsupportedBars(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper) and BarColumnChecks.playerCascadeConsolidatesAcrossBlocks(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper).

    • structuralEditsInvalidateRunBoundsWithinTheTick

      public static void structuralEditsInvalidateRunBoundsWithinTheTick(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: attach automation at different heights, add and remove stack blocks, and split a Storage or Singles run. Every attachment sees the new bounds immediately.

    • runContractPreservesTypeSpecificMutations

      public static void runContractPreservesTypeSpecificMutations(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: automate insertion and extraction in each type. Storage accepts normal stacks and settles; Singles shifts the selected column; Bar backfills from its top position.

    • loadedContentsRefreshComparatorFillAndShapes

      public static void loadedContentsRefreshComparatorFillAndShapes(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce in-game: save and reload partly filled stacks, including an unstackable Storage item. Comparators retain their whole-run fill; loading empty contents clears shapes and fill. Fill and empty the blocks repeatedly: full reads 15 and empty reads 0 after every cycle.
